vulnerabilities.description: Citrix ADC, Citrix Gateway, and multiple Citrix SD-WAN WANOP appliance models contain an information disclosure vulnerability.

vulnerabilities.product: Application Delivery Controller (ADC), Gateway, and SD-WAN WANOP Appliance
vulnerabilities.name: Citrix ADC, Gateway, and SD-WAN WANOP Appliance Authorization Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Citrix ADC, Citrix Gateway, and multiple Citrix SD-WAN WANOP appliance models contain an authorization bypass vulnerability that may allow unauthenticated access to certain URL endpoints. The attacker must have access to the NetScaler IP (NSIP) in order to perform exploitation.

vulnerabilities.name: Liferay Portal Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Liferay Portal contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code via JSON web services.

vulnerabilities.name: Mozilla Firefox And Thunderbird Use-After-Free Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird contain a race condition vulnerability when handling a ReadableStream under certain conditions. The race condition creates a use-after-free vulnerability, causing unspecified impacts.
vulnerabilities.priorityReason: CISA KEV confirms exploitation; EPSS below 10% or unavailable

vulnerabilities.name: Mozilla Firefox And Thunderbird Use-After-Free Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird contain a race condition vulnerability when running the nsDocShell destructor under certain conditions. The race condition creates a use-after-free vulnerability, causing unspecified impacts.
vulnerabilities.priorityReason: CISA KEV confirms exploitation; EPSS below 10% or unavailable

vulnerabilities.name: Google Chromium V8 Type Confusion Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Google Chromium V8 Engine contains a type confusion vulnerability allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

vulnerabilities.name: SAP NetWeaver Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: SAP NetWeaver Application Server Java Platforms contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability allowing unauthenticated access to execute configuration tasks and create administrative users.

vulnerabilities.name: SAP Solution Manager Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: SAP Solution Manager User Experience Monitoring contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which results in complete compromise of all SMDAgents connected to the Solution Manager.

vulnerabilities.name: F5 BIG-IP Traffic Management User Interface (TMUI) Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: F5 BIG-IP Traffic Management User Interface (TMUI) contains a remote code execution vulnerability in undisclosed pages.

vulnerabilities.name: Unraid Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Unraid contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows attackers to gain access to the administrative interface. This CVE is chainable with CVE-2020-5847 for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Unraid Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Unraid contains a vulnerability due to the insecure use of the extract PHP function that can be abused to execute remote code as root. This CVE is chainable with CVE-2020-5849 for initial access.

vulnerabilities.name: Amcrest Cameras and NVR Stack-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Amcrest cameras and NVR contain a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability through port 37777 that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to crash the device and possibly execute code.

vulnerabilities.name: IBM Data Risk Manager Directory Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: IBM Data Risk Manager contains a directory traversal vulnerability that could allow a remote authenticated attacker to traverse directories and send a specially crafted URL request to download arbitrary files from the system.

vulnerabilities.name: IBM Data Risk Manager Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: IBM Data Risk Manager contains an unspecified vulnerability which could allow a remote, authenticated attacker to execute commands on the system.�

vulnerabilities.name: IBM Data Risk Manager Security Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: IBM Data Risk Manager contains a security bypass vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to bypass security restrictions when configured with SAML authentication. By sending a specially crafted HTTP request, an attacker could exploit this vulnerability to bypass the authentication process and gain full administrative access to the system.

vulnerabilities.name: Multiple VMware Products Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: VMware Workspace One Access, Access Connector, Identity Manager, and Identity Manager Connector contain a command injection vulnerability. An attacker with network access to the administrative configurator on port 8443 and a valid password for the configurator administrator account can execute commands with unrestricted privileges on the underlying operating system.

vulnerabilities.name: VMware ESXi OpenSLP Use-After-Free Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: VMware ESXi OpenSLP contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows an attacker residing in the management network with access to port 427 to perform remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: VMware vCenter Server Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: VMware vCenter Server contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service (vmdir) when the Platform Services Controller (PSC) does not correctly implement access controls. Successful exploitation allows an attacker with network access to port 389 to extract sensitive information.

vulnerabilities.name: VMware Multiple Products Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: VMware Fusion, Remote Console (VMRC) for Mac, and Horizon Client for Mac contain a privilege escalation vulnerability due to improper use of setuid binaries that allows attackers to escalate privileges to root.
vulnerabilities.priorityReason: CISA KEV confirms exploitation; EPSS below 10% or unavailable

vulnerabilities.product: Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD)
vulnerabilities.name: Cisco ASA and FTD Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD) contain an insufficient input validation vulnerability for user-supplied input by the web services interface.  Successful exploitation could allow an attacker to perform cross-site scripting (XSS) in the context of the interface or access sensitive browser-based information.

vulnerabilities.name: Cisco IOS XR Software DVMRP Memory Exhaustion Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Cisco IOS XR Distance Vector Multicast Routing Protocol (DVMRP) incorrectly handles Internet Group Management Protocol (IGMP) packets. Exploitation could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to immediately crash the IGMP process or make it consume available memory and eventually crash.
vulnerabilities.priorityReason: CISA KEV confirms exploitation; EPSS below 10% or unavailable

vulnerabilities.name: Cisco IOS XR Software DVMRP Memory Exhaustion Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Cisco IOS XR Distance Vector Multicast Routing Protocol (DVMRP) incorrectly handles Internet Group Management Protocol (IGMP) packets. Exploitation could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to immediately crash the IGMP process or make it consume available memory and eventually crash.
vulnerabilities.priorityReason: CISA KEV confirms exploitation; EPSS below 10% or unavailable

vulnerabilities.product: Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD)
vulnerabilities.name: Cisco ASA and FTD Read-Only Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD) contain an improper input validation vulnerability when HTTP requests process URLs.  An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a crafted HTTP request containing directory traversal character sequences to an affected device. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to view arbitrary files within the web services file system on the targeted device.

vulnerabilities.name: Cisco IP Phones Web Server Remote Code Execution and Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Cisco IP Phones contain an improper input validation vulnerability for HTTP requests. Exploitation could allow an attacker to execute code remotely with root privileges or cause a denial-of-service (DoS) condition.

vulnerabilities.name: Cisco IOS XR Software Discovery Protocol Format String Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Cisco IOS XR improperly validates string input from certain fields in Cisco Discovery Protocol messages. Exploitation could allow an unauthenticated, adjacent attacker to execute code with administrative privileges or cause a reload on an affected device.

vulnerabilities.name: Zyxel Multiple Products Use of Hard-Coded Credentials Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Zyxel firewalls (ATP, USG, VM) and AP Controllers (NXC2500 and NXC5500) contain a use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability in an undocumented account ("zyfwp") with an unchangeable password.

vulnerabilities.name: D-Link DIR-825 R1 Devices Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: D-Link DIR-825 R1 devices contain a buffer overflow vulnerability in the web interface that may allow for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Apple Multiple Products Memory Initialization Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and watchOS contain a memory initialization vulnerability that may allow a malicious application to disclose kernel memory.

vulnerabilities.name: Apple Multiple Products Type Confusion Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and watchOS contain a type confusion vulnerability that may allow a malicious application to execute code with kernel privileges.

vulnerabilities.name: Apple Multiple Products Memory Corruption Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and watchOS FontParser contain a memory corruption vulnerability which may allow for code execution when processing maliciously crafted front.

vulnerabilities.name: Netgear JGS516PE Devices Missing Function Level Access Control Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Netgear JGS516PE devices contain a missing function level access control vulnerability.

vulnerabilities.name: Oracle Multiple Products Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Multiple Oracle products contain a remote code execution vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access via T3 or HTTP to takeover the affected system. Impacted Oracle products: Oracle Coherence in Fusion Middleware, Oracle Utilities Framework, Oracle Retail Assortment Planning, Oracle Commerce, Oracle Communications Diameter Signaling Router (DSR).

vulnerabilities.name: D-Link DNS-320 Device Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: D-Link DNS-320 device contains a command injection vulnerability in the sytem_mgr.cgi component that may allow for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: WordPress File Manager Plugin Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: WordPress File Manager plugin contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows unauthenticated users to execute PHP code and upload malicious files on a target site.

vulnerabilities.product: Apex One, OfficeScan, and Worry-Free Business Security
vulnerabilities.name: Trend Micro Multiple Products Improper Access Control Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Trend Micro Apex One, OfficeScan, and Worry-Free Business Security on Microsoft Windows contain an improper access control vulnerability that may allow an attacker to manipulate a particular product folder to disable the security temporarily, abuse a specific Windows function, and attain privilege escalation.
vulnerabilities.priorityReason: CISA KEV confirms exploitation; EPSS below 10% or unavailable

vulnerabilities.name: Apache Struts Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Forced Object-Graph Navigation Language (OGNL) evaluation in Apache Struts, when evaluated on raw user input in tag attributes, can lead to remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: vBulletin PHP Module Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: The PHP module within vBulletin contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution via crafted subWidgets data in an ajax/render/widget_tabbedcontainer_tab_panel request. This CVE ID resolves an incomplete patch for CVE-2019-16759.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Exchange Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Exchange Server improperly validates cmdlet arguments which allow an attacker to perform remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Windows Kernel Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Windows kernel contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.
vulnerabilities.priorityReason: CISA KEV confirms exploitation; EPSS below 10% or unavailable

vulnerabilities.name: SaltStack Salt Shell Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: SaltStack Salt allows an unauthenticated user with network access to the Salt API to use shell injections to run code on the Salt API using the SSH client. This vulnerability affects any users running the Salt API.

vulnerabilities.name: Google Chrome Use-After-Free Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Google Chrome contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows a remote attacker, who has compromised the renderer process, to potentially perform a sandbox escape via a crafted HTML page.
vulnerabilities.priorityReason: CISA KEV confirms exploitation; EPSS below 10% or unavailable

vulnerabilities.name: Google Chromium V8 Incorrect Implementation Vulnerabililty
vulnerabilities.description: Google Chromium V8 Engine contains an inappropriate implementation vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.
vulnerabilities.priorityReason: CISA KEV confirms exploitation; EPSS below 10% or unavailable

vulnerabilities.name: Google Chrome for Android UI Heap Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Google Chrome for Android UI contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability that allows a remote attacker, who has compromised the renderer process, to potentially perform a sandbox escape via a crafted HTML page.
vulnerabilities.priorityReason: CISA KEV confirms exploitation; EPSS below 10% or unavailable

vulnerabilities.name: Google Chromium V8 Type Confusion Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Google Chromium V8 Engine contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

vulnerabilities.name: Google Chrome FreeType Heap Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Google Chrome uses FreeType, an open-source software library to render fonts, which contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in the function Load_SBit_Png when processing PNG images embedded into fonts. This vulnerability is part of an exploit chain with CVE-2020-17087 on Windows and CVE-2020-16010 on Android.

vulnerabilities.name: Ivanti MobileIron Multiple Products Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Ivanti MobileIron's Core & Connector, Sentry, and Monitor and Reporting Database (RDB) products contain an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Oracle WebLogic Server Unspecified Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Oracle WebLogic Server contains an unspecified vulnerability in the Console component with high impacts to confidentilaity, integrity, and availability.

vulnerabilities.name: Oracle WebLogic Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Oracle WebLogic Server contains an unspecified vulnerability, which is assessed to allow for remote code execution, based on this vulnerability being related to CVE-2020-14750.

vulnerabilities.name: Oracle Solaris and Zettabyte File System (ZFS) Unspecified Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Oracle Solaris and Oracle ZFS Storage Appliance Kit contain an unspecified vulnerability causing high impacts to confidentiality, integrity, and availability of affected systems.

vulnerabilities.name: Oracle WebLogic Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Oracle WebLogic Server contains an unspecified vulnerability allowing an unauthenticated attacker to perform remote code execution. This vulnerability is related to CVE-2020-14882.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Netlogon Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft's Netlogon Remote Protocol (MS-NRPC) contains a privilege escalation vulnerability when an attacker establishes a vulnerable Netlogon secure channel connection to a domain controller. An attacker who successfully exploits the vulnerability could run a specially crafted application on a device on the network. The vulnerability is also known under the moniker of Zerologon.
vulnerabilities.notes: Reference CISA's ED 20-04 (https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/ed-20-04-mitigate-netlogon-elevation-privilege-vulnerability-august-2020-patch-tuesday) for further guidance and requirements. Note: The due date for addressing this vulnerability aligns with the requirements outlined in ED 20-04. https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2020-1472

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Windows Spoofing Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Windows contains a spoofing vulnerability when Windows incorrectly validates file signatures, allowing an attacker to bypass security features and load improperly signed files.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Internet Explorer Scripting Engine Memory Corruption Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a memory corruption vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution in the context of the current user.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Windows DNS Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Windows DNS Servers fail to properly handle requests, allowing an attacker to perform remote code execution in the context of the Local System Account. The vulnerability is also known under the moniker of SIGRed.
vulnerabilities.notes: Reference CISA's ED 20-03 (https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/ed-20-03-mitigate-windows-dns-server-remote-code-execution-vulnerability-july-2020-patch-tuesday) for further guidance and requirements. Note: The due date for addressing this vulnerability aligns with the requirements outlined in ED 20-03. https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2020-1350

vulnerabilities.name: Fortinet FortiOS SSL VPN Improper Authentication Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Fortinet FortiOS SSL VPN contains an improper authentication vulnerability that may allow a user to login successfully without being prompted for the second factor of authentication (FortiToken) if they change the case in their username.

vulnerabilities.name: Sophos SFOS SQL Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Sophos Firewall operating system (SFOS) firmware contains a SQL injection vulnerability when configured with either the administration (HTTPS) service or the User Portal is exposed on the WAN zone. Successful exploitation may cause remote code execution to exfiltrate usernames and hashed passwords for the local device admin(s), portal admins, and user accounts used for remote access (but not external Active Directory or LDAP passwords).

vulnerabilities.name: WordPress Snap Creek Duplicator Plugin File Download Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: WordPress Snap Creek Duplicator plugin contains a file download vulnerability when an administrator creates a new copy of their site that allows an attacker to download the generated files from their Wordpress dashboard. This vulnerability affects Duplicator and Dulplicator Pro.

vulnerabilities.name: SaltStack Salt Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: SaltStack Salt contains a path traversal vulnerability in the salt-master process ClearFuncs which allows directory access to authenticated users. Salt users who follow fundamental internet security guidelines and best practices are not affected by this vulnerability.

vulnerabilities.name: SaltStack Salt Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: SaltStack Salt contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the salt-master process ClearFuncs due to improperly validating method calls. The vulnerability allows a remote user to access some methods without authentication, which can be used to retrieve user tokens from the salt master and/or run commands on salt minions. Salt users who follow fundamental internet security guidelines and best practices are not affected by this vulnerability.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft .NET Framework, SharePoint, and Visual Studio Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft .NET Framework, Microsoft SharePoint, and Visual Studio contain a remote code execution vulnerability when the software fails to check the source markup of XML file input. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to execute code in the context of the process responsible for deserialization of the XML content.

vulnerabilities.name: Tenda AC1900 Router AC15 Model Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Tenda AC1900 Router AC15 Model contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute system commands via the deviceName POST parameter.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Win32k Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Win32k contains a privilege escalation vulnerability when the Windows kernel-mode driver fails to properly handle objects in memory. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to execute code in kernel mode.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Hyper-V RemoteFX vGPU Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Hyper-V RemoteFX vGPU contains an improper input validation vulnerability due to the host server failing to properly validate input from an authenticated user on a guest operating system. Successful exploitation allows for remote code execution on the host operating system.
vulnerabilities.priorityReason: CISA KEV confirms exploitation; EPSS below 10% or unavailable

vulnerabilities.name: rConfig OS Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: rConfig lib/ajaxHandlers/ajaxAddTemplate.php contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute OS commands via shell metacharacters in the fileName POST parameter.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Windows Adobe Font Manager Library Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Windows Adobe Font Manager Library contains an unspecified vulnerability when handling specially crafted multi-master fonts (Adobe Type 1 PostScript format) that allows for remote code execution for all systems except Windows 10. For systems running Windows 10, an attacker who successfully exploited the vulnerability could execute code in an AppContainer sandbox context with limited privileges and capabilities.

vulnerabilities.name: Sonatype Nexus Repository Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Sonatype Nexus Repository contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Zoho ManageEngine Desktop Central File Upload Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Zoho ManageEngine Desktop Central contains a file upload vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Sumavision EMR Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Sumavision Enhanced Multimedia Router (EMR) contains a cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability allowing the creation of users with elevated privileges as administrator on a device.

vulnerabilities.name: SolarWinds Orion Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: SolarWinds Orion API contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute API commands.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Windows Kernel Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Windows kernel contains an unspecified vulnerability when handling objects in memory that allows attackers to escalate privileges and execute code in kernel mode.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Internet Explorer Scripting Engine Memory Corruption Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a memory corruption vulnerability due to how the Scripting Engine handles objects in memory, leading to remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Windows Adobe Font Manager Library Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Windows Adobe Font Manager Library contains an unspecified vulnerability when handling specially crafted multi-master fonts (Adobe Type 1 PostScript format) that allows for remote code execution for all systems except Windows 10. For systems running Windows 10, an attacker who successfully exploited the vulnerability could execute code in an AppContainer sandbox context with limited privileges and capabilities.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Edge and Internet Explorer Memory Corruption Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Edge and Internet Explorer contain a memory corruption vulnerability that allows attackers to execute code in the context of the current user.
vulnerabilities.priorityReason: CISA KEV confirms exploitation; EPSS below 10% or unavailable

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Exchange Server Validation Key Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Exchange Server Validation Key fails to properly create unique keys at install time, allowing for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Windows Installer Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Windows Installer contains a privilege escalation vulnerability when MSI packages process symbolic links, which allows attackers to bypass access restrictions to add or remove files.
vulnerabilities.priorityReason: CISA KEV confirms exploitation; EPSS below 10% or unavailable

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Internet Explorer Scripting Engine Memory Corruption Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a memory corruption vulnerability due to the way the Scripting Engine handles objects in memory. Successful exploitation could allow remote code execution in the context of the current user.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft .NET Framework Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft .NET Framework contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Windows CryptoAPI Spoofing Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Windows CryptoAPI (Crypt32.dll) contains a spoofing vulnerability in the way it validates Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC) certificates. An attacker could exploit the vulnerability by using a spoofed code-signing certificate to sign a malicious executable, making it appear the file was from a trusted, legitimate source. A successful exploit could also allow the attacker to conduct man-in-the-middle attacks and decrypt confidential information on user connections to the affected software. The vulnerability is also known under the moniker of CurveBall.
vulnerabilities.notes: Reference CISA's ED 20-02 (https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/ed-20-02-mitigate-windows-vulnerabilities-january-2020-patch-tuesday) for further guidance and requirements. Note: The due date for addressing this vulnerability aligns with the requirements outlined in ED 20-02. https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2020-0601

vulnerabilities.name: Mediatek Multiple Chipsets Insufficient Input Validation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Multiple MediaTek chipsets contain an insufficient input validation vulnerability and have missing SELinux restrictions in the Command Queue drivers ioctl handlers. This causes an out-of-bounds write leading to privilege escalation. This vulnerability was observed chained with CVE-2019-2215 and CVE-2020-0041 under exploit chain "AbstractEmu."
vulnerabilities.priorityReason: CISA KEV confirms exploitation; EPSS below 10% or unavailable

vulnerabilities.name: Android Kernel Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Android Kernel binder_transaction of binder.c contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability due to an incorrect bounds check that could allow for local privilege escalation. This vulnerability was observed chained with CVE-2019-2215 and CVE-2020-0069 under exploit chain "AbstractEmu."
vulnerabilities.priorityReason: CISA KEV confirms exploitation; EPSS below 10% or unavailable

vulnerabilities.name: WordPress Social Warfare Plugin Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: WordPress Social Warfare plugin contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability that allows for remote code execution. This vulnerability affects Social Warfare and Social Warfare Pro.

vulnerabilities.name: ThinkPHP Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: ThinkPHP contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution via public//?s=index/\think\app/invokefunction&function=call_user_func_array&vars[0]=system&vars[1][]= followed by the command.

vulnerabilities.name: Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus (SDP) File Upload Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus (SDP) contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote users to upload files via login page customization.

vulnerabilities.name: SonicWall SMA100 SQL Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: SonicWall SMA100 contains a SQL injection vulnerability allowing an unauthenticated user to gain read-only access to unauthorized resources.

vulnerabilities.name: Apple iOS and macOS Group Facetime Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Apple iOS and macOS Group FaceTime contains an unspecified vulnerability where the call initiator can cause the recipient's Apple device to answer unknowingly or without user interaction.
vulnerabilities.priorityReason: CISA KEV confirms exploitation; EPSS below 10% or unavailable

vulnerabilities.name: Fortinet FortiOS Default Configuration Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Fortinet FortiOS contains a default configuration vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker on the same subnet to intercept sensitive information by impersonating the Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP) server.

vulnerabilities.name: VMware ESXi and Horizon DaaS OpenSLP Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: VMware ESXi and Horizon Desktop as a Service (DaaS) OpenSLP contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker with network access to port 427 to overwrite the heap of the OpenSLP service to perform remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: IBM Planning Analytics Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: IBM Planning Analytics is vulnerable to a configuration overwrite that allows an unauthenticated user to login as "admin", and then execute code as root or SYSTEM via TM1 scripting.

vulnerabilities.name: Atlassian Confluence Server and Data Center Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Atlassian Confluence Server and Data Center contain a path traversal vulnerability in the downloadallattachments resource that may allow a privileged, remote attacker to write files. Exploitation can lead to remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Atlassian Confluence Server and Data Center Server-Side Template Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Atlassian Confluence Server and Data Center contain a server-side template injection vulnerability that may allow an attacker to achieve path traversal and remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Android Kernel Use-After-Free Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Android Kernel contains a use-after-free vulnerability in binder.c that allows for privilege escalation from an application to the Linux Kernel. This vulnerability was observed chained with CVE-2020-0041 and CVE-2020-0069 under exploit chain "AbstractEmu."

vulnerabilities.name: TVT NVMS-1000 Directory Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: TVT devices utilizing NVMS-1000 software contain a directory traversal vulnerability via GET /.. requests.

vulnerabilities.product: Application Delivery Controller (ADC), Gateway, and SD-WAN WANOP Appliance
vulnerabilities.name: Citrix ADC, Gateway, and SD-WAN WANOP Appliance Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Citrix ADC, Citrix Gateway, and multiple Citrix SD-WAN WANOP appliance models contain an unspecified vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to perform code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Netis WF2419 Devices Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Netis WF2419 devices contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an attacker to perform remote code execution as root through the router's web management page.

vulnerabilities.name: TeamViewer Desktop Bypass Remote Login Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: TeamViewer Desktop allows for bypass of remote-login access control because the same AES key is used for different customers' installations. If an attacker were to know this key, they could decrypt protected information stored in registry or configuration files or decryption of the Unattended Access password to the system (which allows for remote login to the system).
vulnerabilities.priorityReason: CISA KEV confirms exploitation; EPSS below 10% or unavailable

vulnerabilities.name: Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability through RadAsyncUpload which leads to code execution on the server in the context of the w3wp.exe process.

vulnerabilities.name: Trend Micro OfficeScan Directory Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Trend Micro OfficeScan contains a directory traversal vulnerability by extracting files from a zip file to a specific folder on the OfficeScan server, leading to remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Apache Solr VelocityResponseWriter Plug-In Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: The Apache Solr VelocityResponseWriter plug-in contains an unspecified vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Mozilla Firefox And Thunderbird Type Confusion Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird contain a type confusion vulnerability due to incorrect alias information in the IonMonkey JIT compiler when setting array elements.

vulnerabilities.name: vBulletin PHP Module Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: The PHP module within vBulletin contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution via the widgetConfig[code] parameter in an ajax/render/widget_php routestring request.

vulnerabilities.product: Small Business RV320 and RV325 Routers
vulnerabilities.name: Cisco Small Business RV320 and RV325 Routers Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Cisco Small Business RV320 and RV325 Dual Gigabit WAN VPN Routers contain improper access controls for URLs. Exploitation could allow an attacker to download the router configuration or detailed diagnostic information.

vulnerabilities.name: SIMalliance Toolbox Browser Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: SIMalliance Toolbox Browser contains an command injection vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to retrieve location and IMEI information or execute a range of other attacks by modifying the attack message.
vulnerabilities.priorityReason: CISA KEV confirms exploitation; EPSS below 10% or unavailable

vulnerabilities.name: Nagios XI Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Nagios XI contains a remote code execution vulnerability in which a user can modify the check_plugin executable and insert malicious commands to execute as root.

vulnerabilities.name: Docker Desktop Community Edition Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Docker Desktop Community Edition contains a vulnerability that may allow local users to escalate privileges by placing a trojan horse docker-credential-wincred.exe file in %PROGRAMDATA%\DockerDesktop\version-bin\.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Internet Explorer Scripting Engine Memory Corruption Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a memory corruption vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution in the context of the current user.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Internet Explorer Scripting Engine Memory Corruption Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a memory corruption vulnerability in how the scripting engine handles objects in memory. Successful exploitation allows for remote code execution in the context of the current user.

vulnerabilities.name: Citrix StoreFront Server XML External Entity (XXE) Processing Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Citrix StoreFront Server contains an XML External Entity (XXE) processing vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to retrieve potentially sensitive information.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Windows Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Windows contains an unspecified vulnerability due to the way ws2ifsl.sys (Winsock) handles objects in memory, allowing for privilege escalation. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to execute code with elevated privileges.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Windows Privilege Common Log File System (CLFS) Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) driver improperly handles objects in memory which can allow for privilege escalation.
vulnerabilities.priorityReason: CISA KEV confirms exploitation; EPSS below 10% or unavailable

vulnerabilities.product: Workspace Application and Receiver for Windows
vulnerabilities.name: Citrix Workspace Application and Receiver for Windows Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Citrix Workspace Application and Receiver for Windows contains remote code execution vulnerability resulting from local drive access preferences not being enforced into the clients' local drives.
vulnerabilities.priorityReason: CISA KEV confirms exploitation; EPSS below 10% or unavailable

vulnerabilities.name: Atlassian Crowd and Crowd Data Center Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Atlassian Crowd and Crowd Data Center contain a remote code execution vulnerability resulting from a pdkinstall development plugin being incorrectly enabled in release builds.

vulnerabilities.product: Pulse Connect Secure and Pulse Policy Secure
vulnerabilities.name: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure and Policy Secure Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure and Policy Secure allows an authenticated attacker from the admin web interface to inject and execute commands.

vulnerabilities.name: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure Arbitrary File Read Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure contains an arbitrary file read vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker with network access via HTTPS to send a specially crafted URI.
vulnerabilities.notes: Reference CISA's ED 21-03 (https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/ed-21-03-mitigate-pulse-connect-secure-product-vulnerabilities) for further guidance and requirements. Note: The due date for addressing this vulnerability aligns with the requirements outlined in ED 21-03. https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2019-11510

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Windows Error Reporting (WER) Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Windows Error Reporting (WER) contains a privilege escalation vulnerability due to the way it handles files, allowing for code execution in kernel mode.
vulnerabilities.priorityReason: CISA KEV confirms exploitation; EPSS below 10% or unavailable

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Win32k Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Win32k fails to properly handle objects in memory causing privilege escalation. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to run code in kernel mode.
vulnerabilities.priorityReason: CISA KEV confirms exploitation; EPSS below 10% or unavailable

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Win32k Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Win32k contains a privilege escalation vulnerability due to the component failing to properly handle objects in memory. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to run code in kernel mode.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Win32k Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Win32k contains an unspecified vulnerability due to it failing to properly handle objects in memory causing privilege escalation. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to run code in kernel mode.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Win32k Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Win32k contains a privilege escalation vulnerability when the Win32k component fails to properly handle objects in memory. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to execute code in kernel mode.
vulnerabilities.priorityReason: CISA KEV confirms exploitation; EPSS below 10% or unavailable

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Remote Desktop Services Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Remote Desktop Services, formerly known as Terminal Service, contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to connect to the target system using RDP and send specially crafted requests. Successful exploitation allows for remote code execution. The vulnerability is also known under the moniker of BlueKeep.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft SharePoint Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft SharePoint fails to check the source markup of an application package. An attacker who successfully exploits the vulnerability could run remote code in the context of the SharePoint application pool and the SharePoint server farm account.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft MSHTML Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft MSHTML engine contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows for remote code execution vulnerability.

vulnerabilities.name: Apache HTTP Server Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Apache HTTP Server, with MPM event, worker or prefork, code executing in less-privileged child processes or threads (including scripts executed by an in-process scripting interpreter) could execute code with the privileges of the parent process (usually root) by manipulating the scoreboard.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Internet Explorer Scripting Engine Memory Corruption Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a memory corruption vulnerability due to how the Scripting Engine handles objects in memory, leading to remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Drupal Core Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Drupal Core contains a remote code execution vulnerability that could allow an attacker to exploit multiple attack vectors on a Drupal site, resulting in complete site compromise.

vulnerabilities.name: Exim Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Exim contains a buffer overflow vulnerability in the base64d function part of the SMTP listener that may allow for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Adobe ColdFusion Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Adobe ColdFusion contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow for code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Adobe Flash Player Use-After-Free Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Adobe Flash Player contains a use-after-free vulnerability that could allow for code execution.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: The impacted product is end-of-life and should be disconnected if still in use.

vulnerabilities.name: SAP Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: SAP Customer Relationship Management (CRM) contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an attacker to exploit insufficient validation of path information provided by users.

vulnerabilities.name: ThinkPHP "noneCms" Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: ThinkPHP "noneCms" contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution through crafted use of the filter parameter.

vulnerabilities.name: DotNetNuke (DNN) Inadequate Encryption Strength Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: DotNetNuke (DNN) contains an inadequate encryption strength vulnerability resulting from the use of a weak encryption algorithm to protect input parameters. This CVE ID resolves an incomplete patch for CVE-2018-15811.

vulnerabilities.name: Adobe ColdFusion Unrestricted File Upload Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Adobe ColdFusion contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability that could allow for code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: DotNetNuke (DNN) Inadequate Encryption Strength Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: DotNetNuke (DNN) contains an inadequate encryption strength vulnerability resulting from the use of a weak encryption algorithm to protect input parameters.

vulnerabilities.name: Tenda AC7, AC9, and AC10 Routers Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Tenda AC7, AC9, and AC10 devices contain a command injection vulnerability due to  the "formsetUsbUnload" function executes a dosystemCmd function with untrusted input. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to execute OS commands via a crafted goform/setUsbUnload request.
vulnerabilities.priorityReason: CISA KEV confirms exploitation; EPSS below 10% or unavailable

vulnerabilities.name: Fortinet FortiOS SSL VPN Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Fortinet FortiOS SSL VPN web portal contains a path traversal vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to download FortiOS system files through specially crafted HTTP resource requests.

vulnerabilities.name: Apache Struts Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Apache Struts contains a vulnerability that allows for remote code execution under two circumstances. One, where the alwaysSelectFullNamespace option is true and the value isn't set for a result defined in underlying configurations and in same time, its upper package configuration have no or wildcard namespace.  Or, using URL tag which doesn't have value and action set and in same time, its upper package configuration have no or wildcard namespace.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Office Memory Corruption Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Office contains a memory corruption vulnerability due to the way objects are handled in memory. Successful exploitation allows for remote code execution in the context of the current user. This vulnerability is known to be chained with CVE-2018-0798.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Office Memory Corruption Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Office contains a memory corruption vulnerability due to the way objects are handled in memory. Successful exploitation allows for remote code execution in the context of the current user. This vulnerability is known to be chained with CVE-2018-0802.

vulnerabilities.name: Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) contains an improper input validation vulnerability with HTTP URLs. Exploitation could allow an attacker to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) condition or information disclosure.

vulnerabilities.name: Cisco IOS and IOS XE Software Smart Install Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Cisco IOS and IOS XE Software improperly validates packet data, allowing an unauthenticated, remote attacker to trigger a reload of an affected device, cause a denial-of-service (DoS) condition, or perform code execution on the affected device.

vulnerabilities.name: DotNetNuke (DNN) Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: DotNetNuke (DNN) contains a vulnerability that may allow for remote code execution via cookie deserialization.

vulnerabilities.name: Apache Struts Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Apache Struts REST Plugin uses an XStreamHandler with an instance of XStream for deserialization without any type filtering, which can lead to remote code execution when deserializing XML payloads.

vulnerabilities.name: Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX and Sitefinity Cryptographic Weakness Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX and Sitefinity have a cryptographic weakness in Telerik.Web.UI.dll that can be exploited to disclose encryption keys (Telerik.Web.UI.DialogParametersEncryptionKey and/or the MachineKey), perform cross-site-scripting (XSS) attacks, compromise the ASP.NET ViewState, and/or upload and download files.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft .NET Framework Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft .NET Framework contains a remote code execution vulnerability when processing untrusted input that could allow an attacker to take control of an affected system.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Windows Server Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Windows Server 2003 R2 contains a buffer overflow vulnerability in Internet Information Services (IIS) 6.0 which allows remote attackers to execute code via a long header beginning with "If: <http://" in a PROPFIND request.

vulnerabilities.name: Symantec Messaging Gateway Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Symantec Messaging Gateway contains an unspecified vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution. With the ability to perform remote code execution, an attacker may also desire to perform privilege escalating actions.

vulnerabilities.name: Apache Struts Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Apache Struts Jakarta Multipart parser allows for malicious file upload using the Content-Type value, leading to remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Roundcube Webmail File Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Roundcube Webmail contains a file disclosure vulnerability caused by insufficient input validation in conjunction with file-based attachment plugins, which are used by default.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Office Memory Corruption Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Office contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows remote code execution in the context of the current user.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Office Outlook Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Office Outlook contains a security feature bypass vulnerability due to improperly handling objects in memory. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to execute commands.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Office and WordPad Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Office and WordPad contain an unspecified vulnerability due to the way the applications parse specially crafted files. Successful exploitation allows for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Windows Server Message Block (SMBv1) Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Windows Server Message Block 1.0 (SMBv1) contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: SAP NetWeaver XML External Entity (XXE) Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: SAP NetWeaver Application Server Java Platforms contains an unspecified vulnerability in BC-BMT-BPM-DSK which allows remote, authenticated users to conduct XML External Entity (XXE) attacks.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Win32k Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Win32k kernel-mode driver fails to properly handle objects in memory which allows for privilege escalation. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to run code in kernel mode.

vulnerabilities.name: Apache Shiro Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Apache Shiro contains a vulnerability which may allow remote attackers to execute code or bypass intended access restrictions via an unspecified request parameter when a cipher key has not been configured for the "remember me" feature.

vulnerabilities.name: SAP NetWeaver Directory Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: SAP NetWeaver Application Server Java Platforms contains a directory traversal vulnerability via a ..\ (dot dot backslash) in the fileName parameter to CrashFileDownloadServlet. This allows remote attackers to read files.

vulnerabilities.name: ImageMagick Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: ImageMagick contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows attackers to perform server-side request forgery (SSRF) via a crafted image.

vulnerabilities.name: ImageMagick Arbitrary File Deletion Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: ImageMagick contains an unspecified vulnerability that could allow users to delete files by using ImageMagick's 'ephemeral' pseudo protocol, which deletes files after reading.

vulnerabilities.name: SolarWinds Virtualization Manager Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: SolarWinds Virtualization Manager allows for privilege escalation through leveraging a misconfiguration of sudo.
vulnerabilities.priorityReason: CISA KEV confirms exploitation; EPSS below 10% or unavailable

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Office OLE DLL Side Loading Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Office Object Linking & Embedding (OLE) dynamic link library (DLL) contains a side loading vulnerability due to it improperly validating input before loading libraries. Successful exploitation allows for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Windows Media Center Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Windows Media Center contains a remote code execution vulnerability when Windows Media Center opens a specially crafted Media Center link (.mcl) file that references malicious code.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Win32k Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Win32k contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation via a crafted application
vulnerabilities.priorityReason: CISA KEV confirms exploitation; EPSS below 10% or unavailable

vulnerabilities.name: Oracle WebLogic Server Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Oracle WebLogic Server contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability within Apache Commons, which can allow for for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Office Memory Corruption Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Office contains a memory corruption vulnerability due to failure to properly handle rich text format files in memory. Successful exploitation allows for remote code execution in the context of the current user.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Windows Group Policy Preferences Password Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Windows Active Directory contains a privilege escalation vulnerability due to the way it distributes passwords that are configured using Group Policy preferences. An authenticated attacker who successfully exploits the vulnerability could decrypt the passwords and use them to elevate privileges on the domain.

vulnerabilities.name: Oracle Fusion Middleware Unspecified Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Oracle Fusion Middleware Reports Developer contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote attackers to affect confidentiality and integrity of affected systems.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft MSCOMCTL.OCX Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft MSCOMCTL.OCX contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution, allowing an attacker to take complete control of an affected system under the context of the current user.

vulnerabilities.name: SAP NetWeaver Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: SAP NetWeaver Application Server Java Platforms Invoker Servlet does not require authentication, allowing for remote code execution via a HTTP or HTTPS request.
